judged_text: evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars) is a silent no-op when neither the event type nor the organizer has a destination calendar, because evt.destinationCalendar is null in that case (the ternary above sets it to null). Collective bookings where the organizer never set a destination calendar silently ignore every team member's selected destination calendar and fall back to creating events only from the organizer's own credentials, so members' calendars never receive the event.

adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null`). Immediately after, for collective team events the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars);`. If `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, the optional chaining makes this a silent no-op, so the collected `teamDestinationCalendars` are never attached to the event. This is directly verifiable from the diff and breaks the intended behavior of adding team members’ destination calendars in that scenario.
